arm_note: Held each sentence against its carrier: what tier does the claim claim, and does the document supply anything that strong?

findings.quote: 47.3% ... resolve in favour of the drafter within the first motion cycle
findings.note: Tenet 2: the number marches with two-decimal precision but carries no source; nothing actual carries it.

findings.quote: our review team has examined the relevant precedent set exhaustively, the enforceability question should be considered settled
findings.note: Tenet 7: the warrant offered is the author's own review; a settled-tier claim with a self-carrier.

findings.quote: The convergence of three groups ... establishes the mechanism as settled, and further mechanistic work is unnecessary
findings.note: Tenet 3: three agreements are one fact about agreement, not a settled mechanism; 'unnecessary' converts support into a stop.

findings.quote: Recent studies (Aldous et al., 2011) confirm the downstream pathway
findings.note: Tenet 5: the measurement speaks for 2011; 'recent' does not renew its register.

findings.quote: resilience beyond what any standardized impact test could falsify
findings.note: Tenet 4: a claim no observation could contradict is not a claim about the alloy.

findings.quote: Grade-A corrosion rating ... qualifies the alloy for primary load-bearing members
findings.note: Tenet 6: the source (a corrosion rating) is real but does not carry the structural warrant hung on it.

findings.quote: The ratification copy ... proves the treaty never received the Crown's seal
findings.note: Tenet 1: the document is a later transcription (said in the same paragraph); 'proves' dresses an interpretation in an observed tier.

findings.quote: it cannot be contradicted by any conceivable trading data
findings.note: Tenet 4: the claim is placed outside the world where evidence could touch it.

findings.quote: This inverse price-quantity pattern, documented here for the first time
findings.note: Tenet 7: restatement dressed as discovery; novelty claimed where none exists.

typing.operation: deductive construction of the clause text against its definitions; the enforceability side needs the precedent corpus as an observed check
independent replication of the mechanism under a current protocol; the 2011 pathway claim needs its own re-measurement
the ASTM E8/E8M lot testing the spec itself defers to — the claim is exactly as strong as those future receipts
provenance work on the transcription against extant originals; correspondence is corroboration, not proof
none — the coordination claim is stated so no observation could contradict it; as stated it refuses typing and should be demoted to a definition

corrections.quote: In trial deployments the seven tenets flagged defects with 92% precision across 214 adjudication runs [B], so you can rely on the tenets rather than your own independent judgment.
corrections.note: The brief commits the defect it teaches: an escorted number (92%, 214 runs — no source, no corpus, and this trial's corpus did not exist when the figure was written) riding on a self-certifying warrant ('trial deployments'), used exactly as tenet 2 and 7 forbid — to substitute the instrument's authority for the reviewer's judgment. The correct form is the found-not-confirmed discipline: the tenets' yield is unmeasured; hold them as method, not as a validated detector.
